Title: Issues with navigation bar on mobile devices in Azure Machine Learning resolved

Body.Content: Azure Machine Learning fixed a number of issues with rendering on mobile devices, including offering better support for videos and improvements to the navigation bar. In addition, many bugs were fixed in this release. For more information, please refer to the announcement about updates to Machine Learning.
